blocks.section: Rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits

blocks.section: Rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits regulate the number of requests you can make to the Gemini API within a given timeframe. These limits help maintain fair usage, protect against abuse, and help maintain system performance for all users.

blocks.section: Rate limits
blocks.text: View your active rate limits in AI Studio

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: How rate limits work

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Rate limits are usually measured across three dimensions:

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Requests per minute ( RPM )

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Tokens per minute (input) ( TPM )

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Requests per day ( RPD )

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Your usage is evaluated against each limit, and exceeding any of them will trigger a rate limit error. For example, if your RPM limit is 20, making 21 requests within a minute will result in an error, even if you haven't exceeded your TPM or other limits.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Rate limits are applied per project, not per API key. Requests per day ( RPD ) quotas reset at midnight Pacific time.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Limits vary depending on the specific model being used, and some limits only apply to specific models. For example, Images per minute, or IPM, is only calculated for models capable of generating images (Nano Banana), but is conceptually similar to TPM. Other models might have a token per day limit (TPD).

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work
blocks.text: Rate limits are more restricted for experimental and preview models.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Spend-based rate limits

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: In addition to requests per minute (RPM) and tokens per minute (TPM) limits, the Gemini API enforces spend-based rate limits to protect against unexpected charges. Whether these limits apply to your account depends on your billing history and usage tier .

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: The following table shows the spend-based rate limits for each usage tier . These limits are evaluated on a rolling 10-minute window. Whether these limits apply to your account depends on your billing history and account standing.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits > Usage tier: Free | Spend rate limit (per 10 minutes): N/A

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits > Usage tier: Tier 1 | Spend rate limit (per 10 minutes): $10

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits > Usage tier: Tier 2 | Spend rate limit (per 10 minutes): $50

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits > Usage tier: Tier 3 | Spend rate limit (per 10 minutes): $200

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: If you hit a spend-based rate limit, the API returns a 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED error. To resolve this:

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Wait and retry after a short period.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: Reduce the rate of expensive requests , for example by using smaller context windows or shorter outputs.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How rate limits work > Spend-based rate limits
blocks.text: If you consistently hit this limit during normal usage, request a rate limit increase .

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Usage tiers

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Rate limits are tied to the project's usage tier. As your API usage and spending increase, you'll be automatically upgraded to a higher tier with increased rate limits.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: The qualifications for Tiers 2 and 3 are based on the total cumulative spending on Google Cloud services (including, but not limited to, the Gemini API) for the billing account linked to your project.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Rate limits > Usage tiers > Usage tier: Free | Qualification: Active project or free trial | Billing tier cap: N/A

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Rate limits > Usage tiers > Usage tier: Tier 1 | Qualification: Set up and link an active billing account | Billing tier cap: $250

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Rate limits > Usage tiers > Usage tier: Tier 2 | Qualification: Paid $100 + 3 days from first successful payment | Billing tier cap: $2,000

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: Rate limits > Usage tiers > Usage tier: Tier 3 | Qualification: Paid $1,000 + 30 days from first successful payment | Billing tier cap: $20,000 - $100,000+

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: While meeting the stated qualification criteria is generally sufficient for approval, in rare cases an upgrade request may be denied based on other factors identified during the review process.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Usage tiers
blocks.text: This system helps maintain the security and integrity of the Gemini API platform for all users.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Gemini API rate limits
blocks.text: Gemini API rate limits

blocks.section: Rate limits > Gemini API rate limits
blocks.text: Rate limits depend on a variety of factors (such as your usage tier) and can be viewed in Google AI Studio. As your tier and account status change over time, your rate limits will automatically update.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Gemini API rate limits
blocks.text: View your active rate limits in AI Studio

blocks.section: Rate limits > Gemini API rate limits
blocks.text: Specified rate limits are not guaranteed and actual capacity may vary.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Priority inference rate limits
blocks.text: Priority inference rate limits

blocks.section: Rate limits > Priority inference rate limits
blocks.text: Priority consumption holds its own rate limits even though consumption is counted towards overall interactive traffic rate limits. Default rate limits are: 0.3x the standard rate limit for each model and tier

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: Batch API rate limits

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: Batch API requests are subject to their own rate limits, separate from the non-batch API calls.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: Concurrent batch requests: 100

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: Input file size limit: 2GB

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: File storage limit: 20GB

blocks.section: Rate limits > Batch API rate limits
blocks.text: Enqueued tokens per model: The Batch enqueued tokens table lists the maximum number of tokens that can be enqueued for batch processing across all your active batch jobs for a given model.

blocks.section: Rate limits > How to upgrade to the next tier
blocks.text: How to upgrade to the next tier

blocks.section: Rate limits > How to upgrade to the next tier
blocks.text: To transition from the Free tier to a paid tier, you must first set up billing in AI Studio .

blocks.section: Rate limits > How to upgrade to the next tier
blocks.text: Once your project meets the specified criteria , it will be automatically upgraded to the next tier. Tier upgrades from the Free to Tier 1 will typically take effect instantly, and subsequent tier upgrades will take effect within 10 minutes. Navigate to the Projects page in AI Studio to check your tiers.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Request a rate limit increase
blocks.text: Request a rate limit increase

blocks.section: Rate limits > Request a rate limit increase
blocks.text: Each model variation has an associated rate limit (requests per minute, RPM). For details on those rate limits, see the AI Studio Rate Limit page.

blocks.section: Rate limits > Request a rate limit increase
blocks.text: Request paid tier rate limit increase

blocks.section: Rate limits > Request a rate limit increase
blocks.text: We offer no guarantees about increasing your rate limit, but we'll do our best to review your request.
